name: Korean Design Standards (KDS 41, KDS 14)
description: The Korean Design Standards (alpha 9 track C24), a pack that extends the US pack aci318-asce7-22. Seismic by KDS 41 17 00:2019 (the successor of KBC 2016): the seismic zones I and II with the effective peak ground acceleration S of the 2400-year earthquake (Z × I = 0.11 × 2.0 and 0.07 × 2.0), entered as the mapped values SS = 2.5 S and S1 = S of each town; the site classes S1-S6 with Fa and Fv by S; SDS = 2.5 S Fa × 2/3 and SD1 = S Fv × 2/3; the importance factors 1.5, 1.2, 1.0; the base pack's ASCE 7 form of the design spectrum, Cs, the Seismic Design Category bands, R, Ω0, Cd and the drift limits (the same numbers in KDS 41 17 00). Wind: the base pack's ASCE 7 method with the towns' KDS basic wind speed V0 (a 10-minute mean) turned into a 3-second gust (SAEngine practice, × 1.43). Concrete by KDS 14 20 (ACI 318 with the Korean strength reduction factors: 0.85 for tension-controlled sections, 0.70 spirals, 0.55 plain concrete) and the bars D10-D32; steel KDS 14 31 as the base pack's AISC 360-22. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md; the towns' zones and wind speeds and the S1-S6 coefficients are uncertain and must be checked before design.
